## Terraform Provider for SAP Integration Suite v0.6.0

### Overview

0.6.0 makes the API Composition business data graph usable on a real tenant.
Until now the resource was experimental and had never run against SAP: the
Configuration API refused the provider's token. 0.6.0 logs in the way a
tenant accepts it, checks every request against the API's `$metadata`, and
the whole lifecycle of a graph passed acceptance tests. The resource and its
data source are therefore supported.

0.6.0 also separates three support statuses in the feature catalog that used
to be mixed, which changes one value of the feature data sources (see
Breaking changes).

### Highlights

- **Key user login for API Composition.** `provider.api_composition` takes an
  optional `username`, `password` and `origin`. A client-credentials token of
  a `configuration` service key lacked the API's scope on a tenant and every
  request failed with HTTP 403 (code 2707). The token of a user with the role
  collection `Graph.KeyUser`, requested through the same client with the
  password grant, carried the scope and was accepted.
- **The business data graph is supported.** Acceptance tests created a graph
  over a custom OData destination, changed it in place, imported it and
  deleted it. `enable_experimental` is no longer needed. Updating and
  destroying a graph still need `enable_unofficial = true`, because SAP
  documents neither the update body nor the delete request; both worked on
  the tenant.
- **More of the graph configuration.** `description`, `odata_containment`,
  `locating_policy.description` and the `cues` of a key mapping can be set.
  SAP's pages describe OData containment and cue-scoped key mappings, but the
  property names come only from the API's `$metadata`, so setting them needs
  `enable_unofficial = true`. All four passed acceptance tests.
- **Clear status definitions.** Feature Support has a status legend. Three
  statuses are kept apart: 🔬 Research required (known, still under
  investigation, no implementation), 🧪 Experimental (implemented, not yet
  validated on a tenant) and 🧭 Unofficial (validated, but the SAP contract
  is not fully documented).

```terraform
provider "sapintegrationsuite" {
  enable_unofficial = true # update and destroy of business data graphs

  api_composition {
    host          = var.api_composition_host # for example https://eu10.graph.sap
    token_url     = var.api_composition_token_url
    client_id     = var.api_composition_client_id
    client_secret = var.api_composition_client_secret

    username = var.api_composition_username # a user with Graph.KeyUser
    password = var.api_composition_password
    origin   = var.api_composition_origin   # only for an identity provider other than the default
  }
}
```

### Breaking changes

- **`research_required` status.** `sapintegrationsuite_provider_features` and
  `sapintegrationsuite_provider_feature` report `support_status =
  "research_required"` for ten capabilities that are still under
  investigation: data types, message types, service interfaces, classic API
  proxies, virtual hosts and environment key value maps, Edge Integration
  Cell deployment targets, certificate chains, PGP keyrings and Data Space
  Integration. They used to report `unsupported`. The other values are
  unchanged.
- **Cues need a description.** `locating_policy.cues[].description` of
  `sapintegrationsuite_business_data_graph` is required. SAP rejects a cue
  without one, so such a configuration never created a graph.

### Fixes

- Creating a business data graph failed before any request with "Value
  Conversion Error" on `log_messages`.
- Reading a graph with extensions failed: the API returns extensions as
  objects with a name, not as strings.
- Errors of the Configuration API show SAP's details and trace ID. A rejected
  configuration used to say only "Multiple errors occurred. Please see the
  details for more information."
- A graph that SAP marks as deleted is treated as gone.

### Upgrading from 0.5

- No state migration.
- If you list gaps with the feature data sources, include
  `support_status == "research_required"` next to `"unsupported"`.
- For business data graphs: drop `enable_experimental` if nothing else needs
  it, keep `enable_unofficial = true` to update or destroy graphs, add a
  `description` to every cue, and add the key user login if your graphs
  failed with HTTP 403.

The Provider Upgrades guide on the Terraform Registry describes each step.

### Known limitations

- The password grant needs an identity provider that accepts passwords
  without a second factor. A technical user with `Graph.KeyUser` is
  recommended.
- A destination serves only one data source of a graph; a key mapping
  between two data sources needs two destinations.
- A graph can only be read by its identifier; the API does not list graphs.
- Extensions (custom entity projections) are read-only: SAP's documentation
  says the Configuration API does not manage them.

### SAP API references

- API Composition in SAP Help: "Configuration API Specification and Usage",
  "Business Data Graph Configuration File", "Initial Setup" and "Security".
- The Business Accelerator Hub lists the API as Graph - Configuration
  (`Graph_ConfigurationAPI`). Its `$metadata` is not published; the provider's
  snapshot was read from a tenant with a key user's token.

### Compatibility

- Terraform 1.5 or later; 1.11 or later for resources with write-only
  attributes (`*_wo`).
- Terraform plugin protocol 6.
